Title: quick question about Jack of both sides

Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Hi. Is a "Jack of both sides" a equip or employ action?

Jack of Both Sides
Type: Action
Cost: 1 blood
+2 stealth action. Requires a ready vampire.
This vampire equips or employs an equipment or retainer from your
hand. The cost of that card is reduced by 1 pool or by up to 2 blood.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Hi. Is a "Jack of both sides" a equip or employ action?

If used to equip, it's an equip action.
If used to employ, it's an employ action.
